items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: So, old Papa called me over there as we called him. He says, well, come on, let's get to learning these notes here. So he went to teaching me the fundamentals of music.

ctx.x: And there's now, there's still a Louis Teo living who was a brother of young Lorenzo, the very fine clarinetist.

So one brother is still living there. He's still living, but I don't remember him. But the one that finished, well, anyhow, Bonnie went to, he says, well, come on, Papa, I'll take you over. So I went over to one day with him. And Bonnie took his lessons first. Then after he went through his, he was already playing the clarinet, but I hadn't even decided on the horn yet.
